_comment: MANUAL - there is no pipeline write API in GHL v2. Rename the existing stages in the UI on Sales Pipeline zXP0R6qnjGEskUroY9M6. The base workflows are BOUND to these stages, so RENAME them, never delete and recreate.
_core_principle: Research finding #1: 'held' is three states, not one. Quote sent != agreement signed != deposit paid. Only the last one holds a date. A single-asset operator has NO recovery from a double-book - there is no second unit to send - so the pipeline must make the difference between a soft hold and a real booking impossible to misread at a glance.

stage_renames.note: Date requested, nothing confirmed. Speed-to-lead clock starts here.
Event date, venue, guest count and indoor/outdoor captured; operator has checked the unit calendar.
Discovery call or corporate consult booked.
Highest-leak stage in the pipeline. Research: quotes die because 9 other vendors answered first.
THE booking moment. Only here is the date actually off the board and blocked on the unit calendar.
T+48h review request plus the anniversary rebooking hook.

stages_to_add.name: Agreement Sent - AWAITING SIGNATURE
stages_to_add._why: Research #1: the gap between quote-sent and signed is where operators wrongly believe a date is held. Making it a visible stage means an unsigned agreement cannot hide inside 'follow-up'. NOTE: the date is NOT held here.

stages_to_add.name: Signed - Deposit Invoice Sent
stages_to_add._why: Client requirement: the deposit invoice auto-sends on signature. This stage is what that automation drops into, and it isolates 'signed but not paid' - still not held.

stages_to_add.name: Booked - Pre-Event Prep
stages_to_add._why: Everything between deposit and event day: balance chase, COI, permit, space/power confirmation, weather watch. Research #7 - COI has carrier lead time and cannot be an afterthought.

stages_to_add.name: Weather Hold / At Risk
stages_to_add._why: Research #6: outdoor events need a distinct state at T-72h/T-24h/event morning. A weather-threatened booking is operationally different from a healthy one and must be visible, not remembered.

stages_to_add.name: Event Delivered
stages_to_add._why: Research lesson mined from the Roofing pack: pipelines that end at 'won' cannot distinguish a stalled job from a finished one. The event actually happening is its own fact.

delete_pipeline.name: Solar Leads or Plumbers
delete_pipeline._why: Base snapshot artifact, 13 solar-specific stages including 'Received UB'. Wrong trade, delete in UI.

_deployment_notes: Rename before adding - the base workflows reference stages by id, and renaming preserves the id.
Only ONE pipeline. A second pipeline would require rebuilding automation that has no write API.
Opportunity value = Quoted Amount. Set it at Quote Sent so the pipeline reports real revenue.
'Deposit Paid - DATE HELD' is deliberately shouty. It is the single stage where a mistake costs a Saturday.
_status: DONE 2026-09-03 via Playwright: 7 stages renamed inline in the UI, then the Save request (PUT services.leadconnectorhq.com/opportunities/pipelines/{id}, token-id + channel:APP + source:WEB_USER) was replayed with all 12 stages; Solar pipeline deleted with DELETE on the same route. Verified via public API.
